rows.en: "Flag 1B0 has not been set. To play this private
event, set flag 1B0 and try again.
Otherwise, the event will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
Is someone on it, I wonder?"
Touya: "Well, people do ride it."
Yamato: "But whenever I see it, it's stopped.
Right on that floor, too."
Touya: "It's your imagination. Your imagination. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To protect the one I love, my blade of justice strikes the foe!
Crimson blood burns red! Such is the way a man must live!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aaah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You ought to get Gabon to examine you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I am the very picture of health!
I'm not so feeble that I'd get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, what did you think? I'm quite confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent scares me."
It's pretty good, isn't it?
Sounds like enka.
Fain: "Doesn't it? Especially that last part!
Even I get a thrill saying it."
Yamato: "He's intoxicated with himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, good luck."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Maybe something like 'a song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? You mean a song that speaks
directly to the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! Then my proclamation is just that
wonderful!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
Dying for it would be my heart's desire!
And this justice is also to protect those dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. Those dear to you, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not
so fickle! Oh, what should I do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep away..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I've decided in my heart to love only one woman.
But I have the noble and supreme
duty of guarding the princess. I can abandon neither love nor loyalty.
Ah... What an ordeal! This is a knight's destiny!
Then I shall press on! To battle fate!
No, wait. But desiring too much at once
is the same as losing everything, as my master said.
Does that mean I have to follow one path or the other?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And choosing between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! This is all because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If it weren't for them, I wouldn't have had to endure
this suffering...
Wait! Could this be their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, won't let a little thing like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their plan against them, my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess, all at once...
Is that what I must protect?
No, but that would go against my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it rough too."
Touya: "Well, I suppose he's enjoying life in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "Oh, wait a moment."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Yamato: "This feeling... Ah, just as I thought..."
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Yamato: "Hmm. It's fine to go in, but be quiet."
Touya: "Huh?"
Yamato: "Okay? Be quiet."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Touya: "Oh..."
Yamato: "As I thought, she was asleep.
It felt different from usual."
Touya: "Hmm? What's this paper?
It looks handwritten... Can you read it?"
Yamato: "Of course I can't read it!
I don't know the characters."
Touya: "O-Okay..."
Ymir: "...Mmm..."
Yamato: "...Oh, she woke up."
Touya: "H-Hey."
Ymir: "...Huh...? Here........Where am I...?"
Yamato: "...She seems half asleep."
Touya: "...Yeah."
Ymir: "...Mmm..."
Yamato: "...Still half asleep."
Touya: "...Yeah."
Ymir: "Oh!"
Yamato: "Looks like she's awake now."
Touya: "...Yeah."
Ymir: "Haha, hahahaha... G-Good morning."
Touya: "Good morning."
Ymir: "U-Um... Did I say anything strange?"
Touya: "Come to think of it, you asked the same thing last time, didn't you?"
Ymir: "Huh? D-Did I...?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Ymir: "...You seem to catch me like this a lot."
Touya: "Now that you mention it, yeah."
Yamato: "Maybe you two are bound by fate."
Ymir: "H-Hey, Yamato-chan?!"
Yamato: "Hahaha! I'm joking, joking."
Ymir: "Honestly.
<FC:28:3E><FC:84:3C:19:10><FC:02:3E><FC:84:3C:19:F4>U-Um... Did I really not say anything?"
Touya: "Yeah, nothing in particular... You were half asleep when you woke up, though."
Ymir: "R-Right. Yes, I'm not very good at waking up.
So mornings are hard..."
Yamato: "...So it seems. Oh, hey, by the way,
why were you sleeping here?"
Ymir: "The anti-field unit's output was
fluctuating a little, and I was thinking about how to fix it."
Yamato: "Does that mean it's unstable?"
Ymir: "No. There's no problem with its operation or effect.
It's just that even a little thing that seems unrelated
could lead to trouble with this sort of thing."
Touya: "Sure, but... You've been working without a break, haven't you?
You'll ruin your health if you don't rest a little."
Ymir: "Thank you for worrying about me.
<FC:28:3E><FC:04:3C:19:02><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:19:F0>But I'm all right. Besides, this is the only way I can be
useful..."
Touya: "That's not true. You're doing plenty, Ymir.
And even if Celica designed the Spirit Mechs,
they wouldn't have come this far without Ymir, would they?"
Yamato: "Exactly. Why do you think that?"
Ymir: "Touya and everyone else risk their lives
fighting, and all I can do is watch..."
Touya: "I don't think there's anyone who can do everything.
There are things only you can do, Ymir,
and protecting the Liebhofen means protecting the place
we can come back to. That's plenty of help.
Besides, knowing you support us from the rear, Ymir,
really puts my mind at ease."
Ymir: "R-Really...?"
Yamato: "No one's complaining, are they?
Everyone trusts you."
Ymir: "I'd be glad if that's true.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:0A><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:19:09><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:19:F2>Right! Then, for everyone's sake, I'll have to work
even harder."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ymir: "Thank you. I feel like a weight's been lifted.
See you, then."
Yamato: "...Did that have the opposite effect?"
Touya: "Hmm..."
